newsitem.title: USA: Oakley founder Jannard to buy one mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Oakley founder Jannard to buy one mln shrs.

text.p: Oakley Inc Tuesday said Jim Jannard, its chairman and president, has advised the company he intends to purchase up to an additional one million shares of Oakley stock from time to time in the open market, subject to market conditions.

Oakley said Jannard also advised the company he has completed the previously announced purchase of one million shares on the open market, which increased Jannard's ownership stake to over 50 percent of Oakley.
Oakley is a designer, manufacturer and distributor of high-performance eyewear.
